newsitem.title: USA: Royce Micro-Cap Trust sets share offering.
newsitem.headline: Royce Micro-Cap Trust sets share offering.

text.p: The Royce Micro-Cap Trust Inc, which invests in company's with market capitalizations of $300 million or less, said it plans to offer up to 1.6 million shares of its cumulative preferred stock at $25 a share.

Smith Barney Inc and PaineWebber Inc will underwrite the offering, which is contingent on the stock receiving an "aaa" rating from Moody's Investors Service Inc. The fund said it will apply to list the shares on the American Stock Exchange.
Shares of the trust, which is run by Charles Royce, closed up 1/4 to 8-3/4 on Monday.
